channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Nearly 70 million children now have a Trump Account, but parents must claim it
item.description: The Treasury auto-enrolled over 60 million children, with $4.5 billion contributed since July. However, the government's seed money goes only to eligible kids.

item.title: Jeff Bezos says success is wrongly portrayed as villainous
item.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, worth $372 billion, says Americans have been taught to view billionaire success incorrectly.

item.title: Strategy purchases $21 million in Bitcoin as corporate crypto buying revives
item.description: Bitcoin's rebound has prompted some corporate sellers to become buyers again after months of market volatility.

item.title: Vikrom Kromadit expands industrial park empire to Laos
item.description: The Amata CEO cites Laos's green-energy potential, calling the landlocked country "the battery of Southeast Asia."
